prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Korean silver fox goddess luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone elegant silver-era maturity, late 40s, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white hair in a sleek high ponytail — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 thick horizontal stripes by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 77% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 3 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 2 is the stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but lightning web formations in ELECTRIC EMERALD and NEON YELLOW glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
